about: Site updates shown on /changes. One entry per working session: changes within 2 hours of the previous entry's time are added to it (and its time moves to the latest change); otherwise a new entry goes on top. Plain, short lines a rider would care about. See CLAUDE.md.

items: New sign-ups get a two-minute setup: pick parks (search, Near me or Locations), check the coasters you've ridden, then rank your ten tallest head to head.
Add first-ridden dates (per park or per coaster) and rough ride counts while adding credits.
Add credits now uses the same park-by-park flow, with parks you haven't logged first.
Rankings: a Rank more button places your next five unranked credits by comparison; cards show park and model.
Log a day: new coasters you ride become credits automatically, and you're offered to rank them after saving.
Park and coaster pages: a quiet tap to add a coaster you've ridden.
New riders see a Getting started checklist on their profile.
Save Coaster Hub as a web app on your phone: coasterhub.org/install.
No accidental zooming on phones (except the map); text fields no longer zoom on iPhone.
Site updates now appear here on /changes.
A day copied to a friend now shows in the feed a minute after the original.
Relocated rides count as one credit and have one page, with a History section and riders at each park.
Search matches coaster plus park, park initials (like sfdk) and small typos, and shows former names.
Homepage: search and the database cards at the top; Friend activity for the people you follow.
Profile: Recent visits at the top and far less empty space.
Copy a logged day to a friend (admin).
Fixed rankings sometimes not loading, and /log counting rides twice.
Removed nine parks with no coasters.
